item.text: The member status column already supports `"suspended"`, and actor resolution already rejects non-active memberships. I found seat counters currently count only `"active"` members, so I’m adjusting their definition to count all non-removed memberships while adding explicit suspension guards to assignment and notification paths.

The lifecycle and audit events are in place. I’m now closing the remaining recipient and work-assignment gaps, including filtering suspended members from direct notifications, fan-out recipients, digest generation, and comment mentions.
